title: Qualification gates for native ooRexx D-Bus
summary: Distinct checks for archive integrity, ABI, interpreter, peer buses, callbacks, type fidelity and adapters.
procedure: Hash and inventory exact upstream archives; identify source revision/license and compare historical and candidate sources.
Build the unmodified C++ code against a pinned ooRexx interpreter and D-Bus native libraries, no Alchemy linkage.
Test client/server call, introspection, signal subscriptions, property access, error replies and timeouts on disposable session/private buses.
Test callback interpreter-thread discipline, object lifetime, concurrent requests, bus restarts, cancellations and late signals.
Test byte, uint64, variant type signature, structs, dictionaries, arrays, object paths and file descriptor ownership.
Check system-bus permissions, explicit service registration, and no accidental surface expansion.
Test optional ConnectSelector/Queue Fabric adapter separately from native core.
Record PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN/BLOCKED for each check; never turn missing environment into PASS.
invariants: Archive inventory is not native compile evidence.
A CLI dbus-send successful exchange is not ooRexx execution.
Publication is not proof of compatibility.
